notes: Printer Bot 2.5.0 adds Hype Train receipts. A locomotive prints when a train starts. A conductor's cap marks the top cheerer, and every change of conductor prints. A rail car prints at each level up, and a caboose with the final standings prints when the train ends. The train pieces print long ways down the paper. A new switch under Advanced, Print Hype Trains, turns them on or off, and Test print has a step for each receipt plus an end-to-end test. IMPORTANT: this needs four new triggers in Streamer.bot (Twitch, Hype Train). They come with the 2.5.0 import, so import Printer Bot once more after updating, or add the four triggers by hand. The printer list in the dock also shows which printer Auto-detect chose right after you pick it.
